svg.text: 80 × 90 mm · 2 copper layers · factory male pins soldered directly · no module sockets
ENGINEERING DRAWING — actual placement and pad numbers; not a product photograph
One new two-pin GPIO0 recovery header.
Three axial diodes, two axial resistors.
RF exclusions; dashed strip permits RX trace.
Nylon M2.5 supports, max 5 mm head/body.
U1 top JP1; bottom JP2 (reversed numbers).
J1 isolated 5 V · J2 external 3.3 V buck
J3 WK2132 · J4 ZAC93 · J5 CC1101
J8 XIAO boot · J9 Nano GPIO0 boot
No connector desoldering or underside wires.
Prototype: check exact module fit, plugs, antenna enclosure clearance, power behavior and RF coexistence before fabrication release.
The geometry is reviewed; hardware performance and assembled service procedures remain unmeasured.
